page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the page number and running head at the top. No margin notes or other blocks.

main_text.p: per. Cur autem potiare, mi fili, alienâ? cur in gremio non tua hæreas? cùm ob oculos positas habeat Iova vias hominis, & eius gressus libret omnes. Ipse suis criminibus capitur impius, suorumq; peccatorum restibus implicatur, moriturus sine correctione, & suam tantam luiturus insaniam. Proverb.5.

p.i: Qui uxorem (scilicet bonam) invenit, bonum invenit, & Iova favorem obtinuit. Proverb.18.
Domus & opes sunt hæreditas patria: sed intelligens uxor à Iova est. Proverbior. 18.

Præbe mihi, mi fili, tuam mentem, oculique tui meis delectentur institutis. Nam profundus gurges est meretrix, angustaq; scrobs mulier aliena. Ea sanè latronum more insidiatur, & hominum perfidos conficit. Cui heu? cui heu?

page.notes: Page is clean. The catchword "cui" is at the lower right. The first word "per." is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "alienâ?" and "Præbe" are uncertain readings in the scan. "restibus" is read as printed. Section numbers LXXXI to LXXXIII are bare numbers and are written as paragraphs.
